record.edic_text:
3797 opsimos {op'-sim-os}

from 3796;; adj

AV - latter 1; 1

1) late, later
   1a) of the time of subsidence of the waters of the Nile
   1b) the latter or vernal rain, which falls chiefly in the months of
       March and April just before the harvest
